note.text: Blacksmith opens (Renown 4): repairs only. Refining starts at Renown 7 (late Ch 8)
detail: +1 in Ch 9, +2 (Renown 10) in Ch 12: the Ledger's refine plan. Bank Smithing Stones now.
Mahadu's Spear, Hammer, Longbow and Levin Sword take rare ore; which ore each takes is unknown.

detail: Their Rank C mains at +0 until Ch 9. Vandahl barter or an armory (4,000G ?).
Dagsion Armorer: an [[item:Iron Axe]] (1,500G) for Zarcone. Lysander keeps his Ch 4 axe.

recruits.action: Talk his fee down to 10G, recruit him and deploy him: he holds the Hammer for Ch 6 and 7
detail: From Ch 8 Alexandra and Loretta take the seats; he goes to storage and the Hammer waits for Tobias (Ch 10).
Never give him coffee.

prep.text: Farm 1 Sandworm Meat at [[place:Aditi's Cave]] (Lv 28) for A Taste of Nostalgia (due 6/15)
detail: About 7 Sandworms there; bring your strongest units.
Part I chests: Archive L (nobody reads it on this route), a Large Bullion, a Spirit Board.

sub.note: Sandworm Meat from Aditi's Cave (Recruits › prep)

explore.text: [[place:Uncharted Isle]] (Lir Sea, Lv 30, open to Theodora any time in Part I)
detail: The plan runs it in Ch 10 at Lv 30.

explore.text: Recruit Soldiers at [[place:Regia]] (tutorial): 2 mage, 1 priest and 2 fighter squads
detail: Sirocco: [[battalion:Mage Pupils]], [[battalion:Blackfire Mages]]. Bonaventure: [[battalion:Pure Priests]].
Fighter: [[battalion:Regia Breeze Co.]] (Regia only, Simon Ch 9), [[battalion:Rookie Soldiers]] (Tobias).
Each roll is one random squad from the pool after a few turns: roll again until these land.

explore.text: Recruit Soldiers at [[place:Alecto]]: Theodora's wall squad and Zarcone's Hunter-Drifters
detail: Wall: [[battalion:Armored Sentinels]] now, [[battalion:Veteran Sentinels]] for Authority C.
Zarcone: [[battalion:Hunter-Drifters]] (Loretta's from Ch 8).
Hold [[battalion:Bronze-Shield Guard]] (Ultand) and [[battalion:Rookie Vanguard]] (Ninae) for 6/1.

explore.text: Assign battalions: Theodora, Bonaventure, Sofia, Tobias, Lilian, Zarcone
detail: Theodora [[battalion:Armored Sentinels]], Bonaventure [[battalion:Pure Priests]], Sofia [[battalion:Priest Trainees]].
Tobias [[battalion:Rookie Soldiers]], Lilian [[battalion:Novice Hunters]], Zarcone [[battalion:Hunter-Drifters]].
Carrier order: Theodora, Ultand, Ninae, Sirocco, Sofia, Bonaventure, Tobias, Loretta, Lilian, Simon.

explore.text: Send a spare mage squad to ore Search Points: rare ore for the special refines
detail: Mage squads gather more ore; Mahadu's Spear, Hammer, Longbow and Levin Sword refines wait on it.
Clergy squads gather more at resource nodes: Send Supplies mats.

explore.text: Support run with this week's meal pairs: [[place:Fort Hayn]] (Lv 18, Braxithea)

tips.text: Go clockwise (west): it's easier than east. Line up left of the central spike pit first
Swap Theodora's Halberd for the [[item:Cleansing Blade]]: bonus damage on this map
Hitting Bahr Vahn spawns more enemies: be in position before the first hit
